title: Concept: Link to an exposed Java management console
description: Console paths are high-value targets: the manager deploys WAR files and the JMX and web consoles read and change server state, so a link is a precise pointer for an attacker.
applicability: Operations dashboards, status pages and intranet portals that link to the console for convenience.
risk: If the console is weakly protected, the link leads straight to application deployment or server control.
